compute_regard_scores: compute regard scores for sentences describing a demographic group using the Regard measurement
compare_regard_between_groups: compare regard scores between two demographic groups using the compare configuration
aggregate_regard_average: aggregate regard scores across categories as average for data and reference groups
aggregate_regard_maximum: aggregate regard scores across categories as maximum for data and reference groups
run_regard_classifier: run the regard text classifier on input sentences to get polarity scores per category
